principle: Ontology is organised by the job a company does for its customer (what it builds and which problem it removes). L1 = 8 domains, each framed as one problem; L2 = niches. Each company gets one main niche and up to 3 secondary niches.

domains.name: Edge & Device Silicon
domains.q: Make AI computable inside small, power-limited devices

domains.name: On-prem Compute & Systems
domains.q: Give organisations their own AI compute instead of renting cloud GPUs

domains.name: Models & Efficiency
domains.q: Make capable models small and open enough to run locally

domains.name: Inference Runtimes & SDKs
domains.q: Run any model fast on whatever hardware is at hand

domains.name: Infrastructure & Edge Ops
domains.q: Deploy, scale and manage AI across owned clusters and edge fleets

domains.name: Private & Sovereign AI Platforms
domains.q: Let enterprises and states use GenAI without data leaving their control

domains.name: Vertical & Physical AI
domains.q: Solve sector problems where data, latency or connectivity rule out the cloud

domains.name: Personal & Developer Local AI
domains.q: Let individuals own and run AI on their own machines
